name: 世界之外的愚人船
detailed_description:
------Background-------

Introduction: Liancheng, a city that 'lives' on the Xiangjiang River, may not be regarded as an ambitious place, but it is definitely very livable. Here, we can wake up leisurely and then go to work or school; we can wander into the alleys during snack time to find some sweet fried dough sticks paired with a bowl of sweet wine for only 5 yuan; we can spend our leisure time at 'waiting-for-death street' to see and listen to the richly Hu-Xiang style opera or chat with the elderly...

------Plot Summary------

Have you ever seen a world beyond this world?

A world of memories, a world of dreams, a world that traps the 'self', a world that expresses freedom and madness.

What is it like?

What is it made of?

If these worlds are destined to be destroyed—

The nauseating 'life' unfolds slowly within the world—

What is 'life'?

Since those worlds are experiences that 'I' have personally gone through.

Which world is real?

Or are they all false—

In any case, let this Fool's Ship continue to sail, across the Xiangjiang! Sailing beyond the boundaries of the world! Sailing toward the end of the world!

Ultimately, this is a game about 'love and sorrow', 'words and metaphors', 'freedom', 'loneliness'.

Please be sure to remember: 'Keep living!'

------Game Features------

· Cute character illustrations and CG

· A fairy tale with a beautiful ending

· Three different endings

Character Introduction:

【Xue Lingyou】

"Self-introduction? Of course, I am Shiling's childhood friend and the smartest, cutest, and kindest beautiful girl in this world!"

"And then, let’s continue to live happily together! o(*￣▽￣*)o"

Xue Lingyou is Shiling's childhood friend, living together with Shiling after her parents' passing, supporting each other in life, and filled with hope. She usually calls Xiaoying "Yingbao."Though appearing lively and cheerful on the surface, she harbors strong feelings for Shiling, accompanied by endless loneliness and tenderness towards her.

Height: 168cm

Weight: "A girl's weight is a secret oh✧(≖ ◡ ≖✿)"

Birthday: June 1st.

【Xia Ying】

"I hate self-introductions, I hate all subjective classifications, so don’t bother me, I still have a lot to do, and life must go on—"

"Huh?"

"You said you hope I curse you?"

"Are you a pervert? OxO"

Shiling's otaku friend, a classmate, enjoys being with Shiling and Lingyou, but is unwilling to show it, usually calling Lingyou 'Little Yuzu'.

The proud demeanor on normal days comes from being unaccustomed to and disliking others' concern, having her own thoughts about the world, and having faced many things due to her father’s passing—

Height/Weight: "Are you looking for death? ▄︻┻┳═一……"

Birthday: August 8.

【Shi Ling】

"You say my world is a galgame?"

"Let me tell you! There are neither girls nor love here!"

The male protagonist of this story, a pitiful child who lost his parents in an accident and suffers from amnesia, has forgotten all past *events*, leaving only *experiences*. In this blank world of memory, he can only think, and then he plunges into a cycle of time and a whirlpool of thought—

short_description: This is a visual novel, in reality we create different worlds that belong only to you for various reasons, and they will gradually fade away with your memories. Please enjoy this time traveling in different worlds with the girls, and then return to where you are meant to exist - your life.
